name: HetrixTools
summary: HetrixTools checks every minute on every plan, including a free plan with 15 monitors from 4 of its 12 locations. Paid plans cost $99.95 to $499.95 a year for 30 to 200 monitors, with SMS and phone credits included each month.

evidence.capability: http and ping checks from many locations

facts.text: A monitor is marked down only when a set number of its locations agree, and HetrixTools suggests more than half of them.
The free plan stays free as long as the account owner logs in at least once every 90 days.
Uptime report history is kept without a time limit on every plan.
The terms state that HetrixTools has no money-back guarantee or refund policy.
Phone call alerts were added in March 2025.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 15 monitors from 4 locations, checked every minute

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: $9.95 on monthly billing. 30 monitors from 6 locations, 25 SMS or phone credits a month

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $19.95 on monthly billing. 60 monitors from 9 locations, 50 credits a month

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $49.95 on monthly billing. 200 monitors from all 12 locations, 125 credits a month

hiddenCosts: Extra SMS or phone credits cost $0.10 each.
Extra monitors can be added to any paid plan at that plan's own rate.

contract.cancellation: No money-back guarantee or refund policy, and fees are paid in advance at the start of each billing cycle.
contract.dataExport: Full uptime history through the v3 API on every plan.
